description:
Option B: pay autonomously in USDC via x402 (agent accounts only).
    Call without payment_signature to get the payment requirements (amount, asset, pay_to, network); nothing is charged.
    Then sign an x402 'exact' payment and call again with payment_signature (the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value).
    If account credit covers the whole total, you get status 'credit_confirmation_required' and a credit_confirmation
    token instead; call again with confirm_credit to place the order.

confirm_credit.description: The credit_confirmation token from the previous call, to place an order fully paid by account credit
confirm_credit.title: Confirm Credit

payment_signature.description: Base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE for the requirements from the first call; omit to get the requirements
payment_signature.title: Payment Signature

use_credit.description: Apply account credit before charging USDC
use_credit.title: Use Credit

name: pay_with_crypto
